integrity: The stationary equations were independently reconstructed from the published seven-compartment ODE; the corrected conditional coordinates are verified by exact substitution. The introducing article Eq. (1), Eq. (7), and Appendix A were compared. No trajectory data were used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Corrects the printed endemic-coordinate family conditional on a positive force of infection. This does not prove that the scalar force-consistency equation has a solution, its uniqueness, local/global stability, bifurcation direction or epidemiological predictions.
title: Corrected endemic-equilibrium coordinates for an NPI-compliance mpox model
